what: Baseline packing uses compute_medians on all parsed rows without latest-attempt dedup
scenario_or_breakage: When a baseline CI run retried a python-tests matrix job, parse_log keeps call rows from every duration section (attempt 0 and 1+). compute_medians pools those seconds per nodeid while shard_totals_per_run dedupes to the latest attempt only. LPT packing can overweight or duplicate retried work and emit a shard-assignments.json that fails Python verification or needs another manual run
suggested_fix: Filter rows to the latest attempt per (run_id, shard) — reuse _split_pytest_shard_attempts — before compute_medians in the Python rebalance path; document the same rule in rebalance.md and cover it in test_pytest_ci_timing.py
